scenes.title: Level 5: Rhythm
scenes.subtitle: Strumming in time
lines: Let's bring your strumming to life with timing, up-strums, and fun patterns like the folk and waltz.

scenes.heading: In this level
lines: After this level, you'll be able to keep a steady rhythm, add up-strums on the 'and' of each beat, and play three common patterns: the folk pattern, and waltz time.
You'll feel confident playing along with music and keeping time with the beat.
Let's start with 'Keeping time' — the first step to strumming in rhythm.
